name: Being A Father
overview: Scripture reveals that being a father reflects God's compassionate care, as the LORD pities those who fear Him just as a father pities his children (Psalms 103:13). Fathers are entrusted with a sacred responsibility to nurture and guide their children in the fear of the Lord, which brings confidence and refuge (Proverbs 14:26) and leads to lasting righteousness (Proverbs 22:6). The joy of a father comes from raising wise and righteous offspring (Proverbs 23:24), recognizing children as a divine heritage and reward (Psalms 127:3). Ultimately, this earthly fatherhood points to God's greatest act of love in giving His only begotten Son for eternal life (John 3:16).
